info.name: Enterprise Employee Portal API
info.description:
Contract tests for the Employee Portal REST API.

The folders run in order and chain through environment variables: the Auth folder stores an access token per role, the Leave folder submits a request and stores its id, and the Approvals requests act on that id. Running the whole collection therefore exercises a complete employee -> manager -> HR workflow.

Run locally with:

    newman run postman/EmployeePortal.postman_collection.json \
      -e postman/EmployeePortal.local.postman_environment.json
